hero.subtitle: A calm digital sanctuary guided by Elena Vance. Mindful vinyasa, somatic restoration, and breathwork crafted for everyday presence.
hero.imageAlt: Minimal yoga studio with limestone walls, oak floors and linen drapes in soft morning light

practices.title: Practices for Mind & Body
practices.description: Sequenced without rush. Selected sessions designed to synchronize your nervous system with the sun's rhythm.

programs.title: Structured Immersions
programs.description: Step beyond isolated classes. Multi-week somatic architectures built to recondition motor habits, reduce chronic cortisol, and elevate everyday vital ease.

instructor.credentials: E-RYT 500 • 18 Years Devotion • Somatic Experiencing Practitioner
instructor.quote: “Yoga is not about touching your toes; it is about what you discover on the way down.”
instructor.bio1: Elena began her study along the banks of the Ganges in Rishikesh before deepening her craft through somatic physiology and therapeutic trauma work in Zurich. Solstice was conceived as an antidote to performance-driven, athletic yoga.
instructor.bio2: Her methodology pairs classical alignment with soft neurological inquiry. Every cue invites you to cultivate intimacy with sensation, unravel habitual holding patterns, and return home to an unhurried mind.

testimonials.title: Sangha Reflections
testimonials.description: Quiet insights shared by practitioners weaving Solstice into their daily lives.

clara.quote: “In a world of loud 45-minute HIIT workouts disguised as yoga, Solstice is a breath of cold pine air. Elena’s cues don’t command you—they hold space for you.”
clara.name: Clara Lindqvist

marcus.quote: “The Somatic Nervous System Reset healed my chronic neck tension in three weeks. The audio soundscapes make my small apartment feel like a mountain sanctuary.”
marcus.name: Marcus Thorne

amina.quote: “Sunday Live Nidra has become non-negotiable family time. Solstice feels less like an app and more like visiting a quiet temple where time moves slower.”
amina.name: Amina Patel
